metadata.description: Educational documentation explaining the separation between frontend, backend, and API in PostSpark 3
metadata.context: Part of the educational track explaining fundamental concepts of web development using PostSpark 3 as example

metadata.description: Frontend handles screens, buttons, forms, navigation, animations, visual state, error messages, and backend calls. Files: App.tsx, Home.tsx, TheVoid.tsx, WorkbenchV2.tsx
metadata.context: Defines what frontend code is responsible for in the PostSpark architecture

metadata.description: Backend handles requests, validates users, applies business rules, accesses database, calls external services, protects API keys, and returns responses. Files: index.ts, routers.ts, db.ts, billing.ts
metadata.context: Defines what backend code is responsible for in the PostSpark architecture

metadata.description: API is the communication contract between frontend and backend. Main entry: /api/trpc. Complement endpoints: /api/extract, /api/brand-dna, /api/auth/supabase-session, /api/auth/supabase-logout, /api/stripe/webhook
metadata.context: Defines how frontend and backend communicate in PostSpark
